## About
Licensed Idaho REALTOR® (License LC54829) with eXp Realty in Post Falls, Idaho. Markets: Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, Spirit Lake, and North Idaho. Public site copy includes 7+ years serving North Idaho and 100+ completed transactions. Google rating published on this site: 5.0 from 27 reviews. No luxury-specialist designation is claimed.
